correctness.rationale: The Fourier concentration is t T_t* T_t after unitary frequency dilation. The r-th exterior power of analytic kernel e^{-2pi i t x u} has unique smallest Cauchy-Binet exponent r(r-1)/2 with Vandermonde tensor. Gram–Schmidt normalization gives coefficient c_r=(-2pi i)^L prod_{j<r} sqrt(h_j(E)h_j(F))/j!, and the Hilbert–Schmidt rank-one limit yields products of leading singular values; quotient of r=n+1 versus r=n gives s_n~(2pi)^n sqrt(h_n(E)h_n(F))t^n/n!, hence lambda_n~((2pi)^{2n}/n!²) h_n(E)h_n(F)t^{2n+1}. Unique top exterior singular line yields convergence of nested spectral projections, then each polynomial eigenmode. Positivity of finite Hankel matrices follows from positive Lebesgue measure. Independent exact moment determinants and quadrature SVD for two disconnected irregular windows at t=.18,.12,.08 reproduced leading coefficients trending to 1 and eigenfunction overlaps >.992. Bounded experiments do not establish the universal limit.
